workout.subtitle: AI uses your local workout history, muscle fatigue, and latest weight to generate a single-session workout you can check off set by set.

exercise.replaceDescription: The planned exercise is {name}. After replacement, muscle groups and calories will be re-analyzed when you finish the workout.

workout.finishHint: All non-skipped sets must be completed before finishing.
workout.finishSuccessDesc: The result was written to today's exercise log.
workout.finishErrorDesc: Writing exercise log failed. Please retry.
workout.aiConfigErrorDesc: Configure the work model in Settings first.

abandon.title: Abandon this workout plan?
abandon.description: This will not write any exercise records. You can generate a new workout plan afterwards.
abandon.successDesc: You can generate a new workout plan now.
